Suddenly Shrek can be found in a nightmare: Oger are hunted, Rumpelstiltskin is Konig and Shrek has never met his beloved Fiona. / Da sich Shrek als geliebter und geachteter Konig langweilt, sehnt er sich nach etwas Abwechslung. programme.title: Asterix in the land of the Gotter / Asterix im Land der Gotter
programme.desc: Julius Caesar has cast almost all of Gaul with his troops, only a small village still makes resistance bitter. To defeat it, his consultants came up with something new: they build a luxury settlement near the Gallic village and involuntarily integrate it into the Roman empire. But Asterix and Obelix know how to defend themselves. The Gauls sabotage the construction work, first with fast -growing acorns and then with the help of Troubadix singing arts. / Julius Caesar hat mit seinen Truppen fast ganz Gallien besetzt, nur ein kleines Dorf leistet noch immer erbittert Widerstand. Um es zu besiegen, haben sich seine Berater etwas Neues einfallen lassen: Sie errichten eine Luxussiedlung nahe des gallischen Dorfes und gliedern es damit unfreiwillig in das Romische Imperium ein. Doch Asterix und Obelix wissen sich zu wehren. Die Gallier sabotieren die Bauarbeiten, zuerst mit schnellwachsenden Eicheln und dann mithilfe von Troubadix Gesangskunsten.

programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: The fun of sport and movement is in the foreground at we move Austria school. The aim of the ORF initiative is to digitally reach schooles and teachers with short movement units and thus to have them taken daily in the Esterreichian classrooms. Neither gymnasium nor sports clothing or special councilors are necessary for this. As an uncomplicated, daily range of movements for the classroom, we want to move Austria school for more exercise and a healthy and balanced way of life. At the start of the expansion of the initiative. We move Austria, 30 episodes with a duration of six to eight minutes with tailor -made exercises for everyday school life in the classroom. The focus is on power, skill, coordination and relaxation in order to be able to better use the often stressful school day. The movement units are pronounced by the qualified sports teacher Karin Wildeder. / Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. programme.title: Football - French League / Fudbal - Francuska liga
programme.desc: Ligue 1 The first is the French professional football league that has 20 teams in the fight for the title of France champions. It was founded in 1932. years and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The most trophy club with ten won titles is AS Saint Etienne but the "green" on the new title are waiting since 1981. years and the time of the Great Michel Platini. The encounters of the French league are an unavoidable event for every lover of this magnificent game. / Ligue 1 prva je francuska profesionalna fudbalska liga koja broji 20 ekipa u borbi za titulom prvaka Francuske. Osnovana je 1932. godine i smatra se jednom od najcjenjenijih evropskih liga. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali "Zeleni" na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Through the Time Corridors with Morgan Freeman / През коридорите на времето с Морган Фрийман
programme.desc: Represented by Morgan Freeman, the series "Through the Corridors of Time" explores the greatest mysteries of our existence - issues that puzzles humanity from all over eternity. Questions that have been reflected in the most sophisticated minds of the human race. Today, science has evolved to a stage where specific facts and evidence may provide us with answers, displacing philosophical theories. "Through the corridors of time" brings together brilliant thinkers and magnificent ideas from different fields of science - astrophysics, astrobiology, quantum mechanics, string theory, and others to reveal the amazing truth about our universe. / Представена от Морган Фрийман, поредицата "През коридорите на времето" изследва най-големите мистерии на съществуването ни - въпросите, озадачаващи човечеството от цяла вечност. Въпроси, върху които са размишлявали най-изтънчените умове на човешкия род. Днес науката се е развила до етап, при който конкретните факти и доказателства може би ще ни предоставят отговорите, измествайки философските теории. "През коридорите на времето" събира блестящи мислители и великолепни идеи от различни сфери на науката - астрофизиката, астробиологията, квантовата механика, струнната теория и други, за да ни разкрие удивителната истина за нашата Вселена.

programme.title: Tourism.bg / Туризъм.бг
programme.desc: Weekly television broadcast dedicated to Bulgarian tourism. The team travels all over Bulgaria and promotes Bulgarian cities as attractive tourist destinations. Only in our show time stops and you can walk through the captivating and beautiful Bulgarian mountains, to conquer the highest native peaks, to take the steepest forest paths. Get to know us the most challenging tourist routes and immerse yourself in the past with the most exciting historical collections of Bulgaria. / Седмично телевизионно предаване, посветено на българския туризъм. Екипът пътува в цяла България и популяризира български градове като атрактивни туристически дестинации. Само в нашето предаване времето спира и можете да се разхождате из пленителните и красиви български планини, да покорите най-високите родни върхове, да превземете най-стръмните горски пътеки. Опознайте с нас най- предизвикателните туристически маршрути и се потопете в миналото с най-вълнуващите исторически сбирки на България.

programme.title: In the rhythm of the city / В ритъма на града
programme.desc: The show brings together the most interesting of worldly life. Topical topics from the world of show business, meetings with interesting young people, with followers on the nets will be awaited. We will hear the rhythm on the street, and Ai Jen Za will help the leader with Wirel news. / Предаването събира най-интересното от светския живот. Ще ви очакват актуални теми от света на шоубизнеса, срещи с интересни млади хора, с последователи в мрежите. Ще чуем ритъма на улицата, а AI Джен Зи ще помага на водещата с вайръл новините.

programme.title: Forgotten by God / Забравени от Бога
programme.desc: Ruel has participated in UN missions in Bosnia and tries to continue his life. She has a girlfriend, but her brothers do not approve of it. In another scandal between their sister and Ruel, they decided to give him a lesson. But the former soldier is able to defend himself and they die from their wounds. / Руел е участвал в мисии на ООН в Босна и се опитва да продължи живота си. Има си приятелка, но братята й не го одобряват. При поредния скандал между сестра си и Руел те решават да му дадат урок. Но бившият войник умее да се защитава и те умират от раните си.

Padom financijske moći talijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada. ...

programme.title: Cottbus - Hannover, Football, German Cup / Cottbus - Hannover, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Sie messen Herzfrequenz und Blutdruck und sollen bei Problemen rechtzeitig warnen. Quarks macht den Test: Was leisten diese schlauen Uhren wirklich und wer kann davon profitieren?Der plotzliche Herztod kann jeden treffen, ohne Vorwarnung, so wie bei Olaf. Mitten auf einer Radtour setzt sein Herz plotzlich aus. "Quarks" erzahlt seine Geschichte und zeigt, wie er dank schneller Hilfe uberlebt hat. Viele Menschen zogern im Notfall, auch aus Angst, etwas falsch zu machen. Was konnen wir tun, um das zu andern? Und: Was braucht unser wichtigstes Organ wirklich?

programme.title: Worldwide / WeltWeit
programme.sub-title: Exit-Strategie. Wo lasst es sich noch leben?
programme.desc: Expensive rents, enormously high cost of living due to the increasing inflation and on top of that, a founded uncertainty, drawn by numerous global crises: from wars on climate change to the situation in the United States, which has become increasingly unpredictable since Donald Trump took office. The "worldwide" reporters: Inside, people have looked at how people adapt to the challenges and which exit strategies work. In the USA - as is so often - it can be directed. From the nuclear disaster to a burger war scenario in the country, when billionaires think about exit strategies, it is not about canned goods in the basement, but about underground luxury villas with home cinema, high-tech filters and gun barriers. Creating a high quality of life for all residents is at the top of the government's agenda in Singapore. The Sudostasian metropolis grows due to its exposed location on the Sudspitze of the Malay Peninsula Uber hardly any natural water sources and is 90 percent dependent on food imports. This creates a high level of uncertainty and the small country wants to reduce it. Isabella Purkart looks at how urban farms on high -rise roofers and projects such as "Edible Garden City" transform unused flat in the garden and revolutionize innovative approaches. Panama pays to the most modern countries of Latin America and has now become a popular residence for foreign pensioners abroad. Nicole Kampl has visited a law firm that specializes in German -speaking people who are like to emigrate. The inquiries are becoming more and more, because in addition to its stable economy and a good health system, Panama scores primarily with the so-called "pensionado visa": "It enables large-scale tax relief, discounts in restaurants as well as in doctors and in pharmacies," says Kimberly Kelley. The American has been living on the Pacific Custody for two years and is happily because she can afford a life here according to her taste. / Teure Mieten, enorm hohe Lebenshaltungskosten durch die steigende Inflation und obendrauf eine gefuhlte Unsicherheit, ausgelost durch zahlreiche globale Krisen: von Kriegen uber Klimawandel bis zur Situation in den USA, die seit Amtsantritt von Donald Trump zunehmend unvorhersehbar wird. Die "WeltWeit"- Reporter:innen haben sich angeschaut, wie sich Menschen auf die Herausforderungen einstellen, und welche Exit-Strategien funktionieren.In den USA zeigt sich - wie so oft -, wer Geld hat, kann es sich richten. Von der atomaren Katastrophe bis zu einem Burgerkriegs-Szenario im Land, wenn Milliardare uber Exit-Strategien nachdenken, dann geht es nicht um Konserven im Keller, sondern um unterirdische Luxusvillen mit Heimkino, Hightech-Luftfiltern und Waffenschranken. programme.title: A Habsburg on Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator and the magic of the sea / Ein Habsburger auf Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator und der Zauber des Meeres
programme.desc: Ludwig Salvator, Archduke of Austria and Prince of Tuscany, traveled and researched the Mediterranean with his sailing yacht for decades and finally settled in Mallorca.* His special interest was the research of unknown islands at the time, from the country and people, flora and fauna. He documented his trips in words and pictures. Magnificent Bucher testify to his universal work.*Archduke Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lorraine and Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) was an unpleasant, a universal genius, an dropout and nature conservationist from the very beginning. However, he was not only a fun -loving globetrotter, but also a recognized researcher of the Mediterranean, especially the Balearic Islands. He has recorded his research results on history, flora and fauna in extensive publications. The documentation shows the most important life stations of Ludwig Salvator and the sustainable effects of his research activity in the late 19th century. Throughout his life, he was driven by the desire to travel, understand and preserve. As the owner of the steam yacht "mermaid" and the "capitan spatent of the long journey", he was in the Mediterranean for decades to awaken the interest of the public for the regions that were largely unknown at the time, such as the Liparic Islands and the Ionian protective of the Balearic and the loveliness of their inhabitants particularly impressed the archduke. He created a small paradise in the northwest of Mallorca, where no animal was tired and no tree was allowed to be. For his monumental work "The Balearic Islands. Described in word and picture" he received the gold medal at the Paris World Exhibition in 1889.Annatuigent legends and anecdotes rose around the "uncrowned king of the Balearic Islands". He neither grief about the appearance that was expected by a member of the Habsburg family, nor about what others thought about him. Because of his scraping clothes, he was kept for a shepherd or farm worker - to his great amusement. He commented calmly that he was considered a scholarly nerd at Hof: "Better diverse than simple". Ludwig Salvator's love life was turbulent. The bachelor is said to have been to both sexes and have had countless affarities. He supposedly took care of his illegitimate children. One of his love affairs, Catalina Homar, the daughter of a carpenter, let the Archduke give an excellent training and finally made them the administrator of his vineyard. Ludwig Salvator was a scientist, artist, visionary, pacifist, nature conservation, writer and one of the most dazzling people from Habsburg. / Ludwig Salvator, Erzherzog von Österreich und Prinz von Toskana, bereiste und erforschte jahrzehntelang mit seiner Segelyacht "Nixe" das Mittelmeer und lieSS sich schlieSSlich auf Mallorca nieder.*Er war gebildet, unangepasst und aufgeschlossen. Sein besonderes Interesse galt der Erforschung damals unbekannter Inseln, von Land und Leuten, Flora und Fauna. Seine Reisen dokumentierte er in Wort und Bild. Prachtvolle Bucher bezeugen sein universelles Schaffen.*Erzherzog Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lothringen und Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) war ein Unangepasster, ein Universalgenie, ein Aussteiger und Natur-schutzer der ersten Stunde. Er war aber nicht nur ein lebenslustiger Globetrotter, sondern auch ein anerkannter Forscher des Mittelmeerraumes, besonders der Balearen. Seine Forschungsergebnisse uber Geschichte, Tier- und Pflanzenwelt hat er in umfangreichen Publikationen festgehalten.Die Dokumentation zeigt die wichtigsten Lebensstationen Ludwig Salvators und die nachhaltigen Auswirkungen seiner Forschertatigkeit im ausgehenden 19. Jahrhundert. Zeit seines Lebens war er getrieben von dem Verlangen zu reisen, zu verstehen und zu bewahren. Als Besitzer der Dampfsegelyacht "Nixe" und des "Kapitanspatentes der langen Fahrt" war er jahrzehntelang im Mittelmeer unterwegs, um das Interesse der Öffentlichkeit fur damals weitgehend unbekannte Regionen zu wecken, wie die Liparischen Inseln und die Ionischen Inseln.Die wilde Schonheit der Balearen und die Liebenswurdigkeit von deren Bewohnern beeindruckten den Erzherzog besonders. Er schuf sich im Nordwesten Mallorcas ein kleines Paradies, wo kein Tier getotet und kein Baum gefallt werden durfte. Fur sein Monumentalwerk "Die Balearen. Geschildert in Wort und Bild" erhielt er auf der Pariser Weltausstellung 1889 die Goldmedaille.Unzahlige Legenden und Anekdoten ranken sich um den "ungekronten Konig der Balearen". Er kummerte sich weder um das Auftreten, das von einem Mitglied der Familie Habsburg erwartet wurde, noch darum, was andere uber ihn dachten. Seiner schabigen Kleidung wegen wurde er immer wieder fur einen Schafhirten oder Landarbeiter gehalten - zu seiner groSSen Belustigung. Dass er bei Hof als gelehrter Sonderling galt, kommentierte er gelassen: "Lieber vielfaltig als einfaltig".Ludwig Salvators Liebesleben war turbulent. Der Junggeselle soll beiden Geschlechtern zugetan gewesen sein und zahllose Affaren gehabt haben. Fur seine unehelichen Kinder hat er angeblich gut gesorgt. Einer seiner Liebschaften, Catalina Homar, der Tochter eines Tischlers, lieSS der Erzherzog eine exzellente Ausbildung angedeihen und machte sie schlieSSlich sogar zur Verwalterin seiner Weinguter.Ludwig Salvator war Wissenschaftler, Kunstler, Visionar, Pazifist, Naturschutzer, Schriftsteller und eine der schillerndsten Personlichkeiten aus dem Hause Habsburg.Eine Dokumentation von Rosa Maria Plattner

programme.sub-title: Exit-Strategie. Wo lasst es sich noch leben?
programme.desc: Expensive rents, enormously high cost of living due to the increasing inflation and on top of that, a founded uncertainty, drawn by numerous global crises: from wars on climate change to the situation in the United States, which has become increasingly unpredictable since Donald Trump took office. Von der atomaren Katastrophe bis zu einem Burgerkriegs-Szenario im Land, wenn Milliardare uber Exit-Strategien nachdenken, dann geht es nicht um Konserven im Keller, sondern um unterirdische Luxusvillen mit Heimkino, Hightech-Luftfiltern und Waffenschranken. Isabella Purkart schaut sich an, wie urbane Farmen auf Hochhausdachern und Projekte wie "Edible Garden City" ungenutzte Flachen in Garten verwandeln und innovative Ansatze die Wasserversorgung revolutionieren.Panama zahlt zu den modernsten Landern Lateinamerikas und ist mittlerweile ein beliebter Alterswohnsitz fur auslandische Pensionistinnen und Pensionisten geworden. programme.title: A Habsburg on Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator and the magic of the sea / Ein Habsburger auf Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator und der Zauber des Meeres
programme.desc: Ludwig Salvator, Archduke of Austria and Prince of Tuscany, traveled and researched the Mediterranean with his sailing yacht for decades and finally settled in Mallorca.* His special interest was the research of unknown islands at the time, from the country and people, flora and fauna. He documented his trips in words and pictures. Magnificent Bucher testify to his universal work.*Archduke Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lorraine and Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) was an unpleasant, a universal genius, an dropout and nature conservationist from the very beginning. However, he was not only a fun -loving globetrotter, but also a recognized researcher of the Mediterranean, especially the Balearic Islands. He has recorded his research results on history, flora and fauna in extensive publications. The documentation shows the most important life stations of Ludwig Salvator and the sustainable effects of his research activity in the late 19th century. Throughout his life, he was driven by the desire to travel, understand and preserve. As the owner of the steam yacht "mermaid" and the "capitan spatent of the long journey", he was in the Mediterranean for decades to awaken the interest of the public for the regions that were largely unknown at the time, such as the Liparic Islands and the Ionian protective of the Balearic and the loveliness of their inhabitants particularly impressed the archduke. He created a small paradise in the northwest of Mallorca, where no animal was tired and no tree was allowed to be. For his monumental work "The Balearic Islands. Described in word and picture" he received the gold medal at the Paris World Exhibition in 1889.Annatuigent legends and anecdotes rose around the "uncrowned king of the Balearic Islands". He neither grief about the appearance that was expected by a member of the Habsburg family, nor about what others thought about him. Because of his scraping clothes, he was kept for a shepherd or farm worker - to his great amusement. He commented calmly that he was considered a scholarly nerd at Hof: "Better diverse than simple". Ludwig Salvator's love life was turbulent. The bachelor is said to have been to both sexes and have had countless affarities. He supposedly took care of his illegitimate children. One of his love affairs, Catalina Homar, the daughter of a carpenter, let the Archduke give an excellent training and finally made them the administrator of his vineyard. Ludwig Salvator was a scientist, artist, visionary, pacifist, nature conservation, writer and one of the most dazzling people from Habsburg. / Ludwig Salvator, Erzherzog von Österreich und Prinz von Toskana, bereiste und erforschte jahrzehntelang mit seiner Segelyacht "Nixe" das Mittelmeer und lieSS sich schlieSSlich auf Mallorca nieder.*Er war gebildet, unangepasst und aufgeschlossen. Sein besonderes Interesse galt der Erforschung damals unbekannter Inseln, von Land und Leuten, Flora und Fauna. Seine Reisen dokumentierte er in Wort und Bild. Prachtvolle Bucher bezeugen sein universelles Schaffen.*Erzherzog Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lothringen und Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) war ein Unangepasster, ein Universalgenie, ein Aussteiger und Natur-schutzer der ersten Stunde. Er war aber nicht nur ein lebenslustiger Globetrotter, sondern auch ein anerkannter Forscher des Mittelmeerraumes, besonders der Balearen. Seine Forschungsergebnisse uber Geschichte, Tier- und Pflanzenwelt hat er in umfangreichen Publikationen festgehalten.Die Dokumentation zeigt die wichtigsten Lebensstationen Ludwig Salvators und die nachhaltigen Auswirkungen seiner Forschertatigkeit im ausgehenden 19. Jahrhundert. Zeit seines Lebens war er getrieben von dem Verlangen zu reisen, zu verstehen und zu bewahren. Als Besitzer der Dampfsegelyacht "Nixe" und des "Kapitanspatentes der langen Fahrt" war er jahrzehntelang im Mittelmeer unterwegs, um das Interesse der Öffentlichkeit fur damals weitgehend unbekannte Regionen zu wecken, wie die Liparischen Inseln und die Ionischen Inseln.Die wilde Schonheit der Balearen und die Liebenswurdigkeit von deren Bewohnern beeindruckten den Erzherzog besonders. Er schuf sich im Nordwesten Mallorcas ein kleines Paradies, wo kein Tier getotet und kein Baum gefallt werden durfte. Fur sein Monumentalwerk "Die Balearen. Geschildert in Wort und Bild" erhielt er auf der Pariser Weltausstellung 1889 die Goldmedaille.Unzahlige Legenden und Anekdoten ranken sich um den "ungekronten Konig der Balearen". Er kummerte sich weder um das Auftreten, das von einem Mitglied der Familie Habsburg erwartet wurde, noch darum, was andere uber ihn dachten. Seiner schabigen Kleidung wegen wurde er immer wieder fur einen Schafhirten oder Landarbeiter gehalten - zu seiner groSSen Belustigung. Dass er bei Hof als gelehrter Sonderling galt, kommentierte er gelassen: "Lieber vielfaltig als einfaltig".Ludwig Salvators Liebesleben war turbulent. Der Junggeselle soll beiden Geschlechtern zugetan gewesen sein und zahllose Affaren gehabt haben. Fur seine unehelichen Kinder hat er angeblich gut gesorgt. Einer seiner Liebschaften, Catalina Homar, der Tochter eines Tischlers, lieSS der Erzherzog eine exzellente Ausbildung angedeihen und machte sie schlieSSlich sogar zur Verwalterin seiner Weinguter.Ludwig Salvator war Wissenschaftler, Kunstler, Visionar, Pazifist, Naturschutzer, Schriftsteller und eine der schillerndsten Personlichkeiten aus dem Hause Habsburg.Eine Dokumentation von Rosa Maria Plattner

Sie stehen zunachst noch im Verdacht Medikamente missbraucht zu haben, um Patientinnen und Patienten auf ihrer Station ruhig zu stellen. Schnell steht aber dann das Wort "Mord" im Raum. Niemand schopfte Verdacht, als uber Jahre nicht verordnete Medikamente verabreicht worden sind. Hat die Spitalaufsicht versagt? Die Wiener Krankenhauspolitik steht unter Beschuss. Eine weitreichende Diskussion uber die enormen Missstande im Pflegewesen wird angestoSSen.Im Gesprach erzahlt der Ex-Kriminalbeamte Robert Jandl uber die Einvernahmen mit der Haupttaterin. Der ehemalige Leiter des Sicherheitsburos Max Edelbacher erinnert sich an TV-Wortgefechte mit dem damaligen Burgermeister Helmut Zilk. Gerichtsmediziner Christian Reiter berichtet uber eine Vielzahl an Exhumierungen und die Beweisbarkeit der sogenannten "Mundpflege".Eine neue ORF-III-Dokumentation aus der Reihe "Wahre Verbrechen" uber die beruhmt gewordenen "Todesengel von Lainz" blickt zuruck auf ein Wien der 1980er Jahre, das, geschockt von einer Mordserie ungeahnten AusmaSSes, vor einer Gesundheitsreform steht.

programme.title: True crime / Wahre Verbrechen
programme.desc: This episode of the ORF-III series "True Crime" has the incredible story of the "Gasmann" Harald Sassak. Vienna - 1971. The capital is haunted by a series of robbery murders. Old, mostly female persons are ranked, galvanized and robbed in their apartment. Many of the victims do not overflow. A phantom will murder over the years where you are actually the safest: in your own four wandes. Disguised as a gas man, he gives himself access to the apartments of his victims. But who is the man who, as the "Wurger von Vienna", is the title sheets of newspapers? Although he leaves fingerprints and cigarette buttocks at the crime scenes, it is thanks to the special talents of an older woman that he is finally carried over. Harald Sassak will go down in Esterreichische History as the most prominent robbery of the second republic. / Diese Folge der ORF-III-Serie "Wahre Verbrechen" erzahlt die unglaubliche Geschichte des "Gasmanns" Harald Sassak. Wien - 1971. Die Hauptstadt wird von einer Serie von Raubmorden heimgesucht. Alte, zumeist weibliche Personen werden in ihrer Wohnung uberrascht, uberwaltigt und ausgeraubt. Viele der Opfer uberleben den Überfall nicht. Ein Phantom wird uber Jahre dort morden, wo man sich eigentlich am sichersten fuhlt: In den eigenen vier Wanden. Als Gasmann verkleidet verschafft er sich Zugang zu den Wohnungen seiner Opfer. Doch wer ist der Mann, der als "Wurger von Wien" die Titelblatter der Zeitungen fullt? Obwohl er Fingerabdrucke und Zigarettenstummel an den Tatorten zurucklasst, ist es den besonderen Talenten einer alteren Frau zu verdanken, dass er schlieSSlich uberfuhrt wird. Harald Sassak wird als prominentester Raubmorder der Zweiten Republik in die osterreichische Geschichte eingehen.

programme.title: True crime / Wahre Verbrechen
programme.desc: The ORF-III series "True Crime" shows one of Austria's most spectacular criminal trap: The case of the Estibaliz C.Am 6. June 2011, which became known as "Eislady", is done in a basement compartment in a basement compartment: in the concrete frame chest and flower trods, body parts are discovered by two men. It soon becomes clear that the men are the former life dangers of the Eissalon owner Estibaliz C. But she succeeds in escape - she can finally be caught in Italy for three days later. What really happened back then? How did the murders come? How could you stay unnoticed for so long? And how did the ESTIBALIZ C. finally caught? Orfiii speaks to familiar, investigators and psychiatrists and is on the trail of crime. / Die ORF-III-Reihe "Wahre Verbrechen" zeigt einen der wohl spektakularsten Kriminalfalle Österreichs:Dem Fall der als "Eislady" bekannt gewordenen Estibaliz C.Am 6. Juni 2011 wird bei Reparaturarbeiten nach einem Wasserrohrbruch in einem Kellerabteil ein furchtbarer Fund gemacht: in zubetonierten Tiefkuhltruhen und Blumentrogen werden Leichenteile von zwei Mannern entdeckt. Bald wird klar: Die Manner sind die ehemaligen Lebensgefahrten der Eissalonbesitzerin Estibaliz C. Doch ihr gelingt die Flucht - drei Tage spater kann sie schlieSSlich in Italien gefasst werden. Was ist damals wirklich passiert? Wie ist es zu den Morden gekommen? Wie konnten sie so lange unbemerkt bleiben? Und wie hat die Polizei Estibaliz C. schlieSSlich geschnappt? ORFIII spricht mit Vertrauten, Ermittlern und Psychiatern und begibt sich auf die Spur des Verbrechens.

programme.title: Our forest - in the realm of water / Unsere Walder - Im Reich des Wassers
programme.desc: Walder are the greatest Susswater storage in the world, because everything in the forest is designed to bunker water for bad times. The tree tops catch a large part of the precipitation before falling to the ground, where the humus -rich surface sucks it up like a sponge. Tree roots, which are floured into a delicate felt by their mushroom friends, store the precious wet. And as through a miracle, it gets back into the crown from the roots - without any engine pumps. Up here it is needed for photosynthesis. Because without water, sugar production in the leaves comes to a standstill and the whole forest grants the stomach too much water, and drowned many tree from drowning the leaves at the top of the sun, the closed crown roof ensures that there is a large dam light under the tree - and for a uniformly kuhles, damp climate inside the forest. Too much water, however, let many tree drown. Like humans, they succumb to an suffocation. AUWALDER are therefore terrain and home of specialists, such as the beaver - the only animal forest dweller who falls tree, but no matter where a forest guard: every forest is a gigantic "water bucket" in a global chain of pump stations. Walder pump the water vapor from the oceans inland. Without them, the large continents were dry out inside. This is not the only reason why our foresters are our most important members of the fight against climate change. And so scientists are researching with aircraft and crown crowns on the Wunderwerk Wald. / Walder sind die groSSten SuSSwasserspeicher der Welt, denn alles im Wald ist darauf angelegt, Wasser fur schlechte Zeiten zu bunkern.Die Baumkronen fangen einen GroSSteil des Niederschlags auf, bevor er zu Boden fallt, wo der humusreiche Untergrund ihn aufsaugt wie ein Schwamm. Baumwurzeln, die von ihren Pilzfreunden in einen zarten Filz gehullt werden, speichern das kostbare Nass. Und wie durch ein Wunder gelangt es von den Wurzeln wieder hinauf in die Krone - ganz ohne Motorpumpen. Hier oben wird es gebraucht fur die Photosynthese. Denn ohne Wasser kommt die Zuckerproduktion in den Blattern zum Stillstand und dem ganzen Wald knurrt der Magen.Zu viel Wasser lasst viele Baume ertrinkenWahrend die Blatter oben die Energie der Sonne einfangen, sorgt das geschlossene Kronendach fur grunes Dammerlicht unter den Baumen - und fur ein gleichmaSSig kuhles, feuchtes Klima im Waldinneren. Zu viel Wasser allerdings lasst viele Baume ertrinken. Wie Menschen erliegen sie dabei einem Erstickungstod. Auwalder sind deswegen Terrain und Heimat von Spezialisten, wie dem Biber - dem einzigen tierischen Waldbewohner, der Baume fallt.Doch egal, wo ein Wald wachst: Jeder Wald ist ein gigantischer "Wassereimer" in einer globalen Kette von Pumpstationen. Walder pumpen den Wasserdampf von den Meeren ins Landesinnere. Ohne sie wurden die groSSen Kontinente im Inneren austrocknen. Nicht nur deswegen sind unsere Walder unsere wichtigsten Verbundeten im Kampf gegen den Klimawandel. Und so forschen Wissenschaftler mit Klimaturmen und Kronenkranen am Wunderwerk Wald.

programme.title: Our forest - the language of the tree / Unsere Walder - Die Sprache der Baume
programme.desc: Even if they are in the same stain for their lives: tree is not silent, lonely beings. In the forest they have friends and managers, family gormic and enemies. And with everyone they are networked. Under the earth, each tree root takes about twice as much flat as the crown in airy high. And in a single tea fuckel Walderde there are kilometers of mushroom mesh, tiny lines that network whole forest - like the Internet our computers. Almost all tree in the forest cooperate with one or more mushroom fans. The underground network even helps the trees to supply their offspring, which is too often in the shade in the damn light of the forest. And chemical messages also float in the forest air, with the help of which tree communicate or ward off enemies. How invisible communication flags blow through the forest. In addition, the air is rich in oxygen - a waste product of photosynthesis. A only tree covers the daily requirement of ten people. That is why the "Waldbad" applies not only in Japan, where it was invented, long as therapy. We become calmer and healthy under tree. Because even if we don't understand it, the secret language of the tree also affects us. Maybe that's why we love the forest so much. / Auch wenn sie ihr Leben lang am selben Fleck stehen: Baume sind keine stummen, einsamen Wesen. Im Wald haben sie Freunde und Geschaftspartner, Familienangehorige und Feinde. Und mit allen sind sie vernetzt.Unter der Erde nimmt jede Baumwurzel etwa doppelt so viel Flache ein wie die Krone in luftiger Hohe. Und in einem einzigen Teeloffel Walderde befinden sich kilometerlange Pilzgeflechte, winzige Leitungen, die ganze Walder vernetzen - wie das Internet unsere Computer. Fast alle Baume im Wald kooperieren mit einem oder mehreren Pilzfreunden.Das unterirdische Netz hilft den Baumen sogar, ihren Nachwuchs zu versorgen, der im Dammerlicht des Waldes allzu oft im Schatten steht. Und auch in der Waldluft schweben standig chemische Botschaften, mit deren Hilfe Baume kommunizieren oder Feinde abwehren. Wie unsichtbare Kommunikationsfahnen durchwehen sie den Wald. Zudem ist die Luft reich an Sauerstoff - einem Abfallprodukt der Photosynthese.Ein einziger Baum deckt den Tagesbedarf von zehn Menschen. Deswegen gilt das "Waldbad" nicht nur in Japan, wo es erfunden wurde, langst als Therapie. Unter Baumen werden wir ruhiger und gesunder. Denn auch wenn wir sie nicht verstehen, die geheime Sprache der Baume wirkt auch auf uns. Vielleicht lieben wir den Wald ja auch deshalb so sehr.

programme.title: At home in the Dolomites - character heads from Sudtirol / Daheim in den Dolomiten - Charakterkopfe aus Sudtirol
programme.desc: Funf character heads have one thing in common: you will find life in the most beautiful mountains in the world. They are bonded with "their" Dolomites, have humility in front of the angular spikes and the moods of nature. "Hebs" looks after 150 cows, 11 horses and 77 sheep and plays rustic golf on 2164 meters. "Isi" doesn't like down into the valley anymore, so fine she has set up in her hat on Jochgrimm. Armin Holzer is the blonde Jesus on the rubber rope that is looking for the kick in the high. And the Piccolruaz family is hiding two treasures - the Ladin language and its 800 years of Alfarèi -Hof. Then Egon Moroder Rusina, who seems to be escaped from the Stone Age. With three goats and a hen, the painter lives on an alpine pasture in the tent in the summer and ahms her breath in the fog. They all live in yesterday, on the contrary, they have a lot ahead of the city people. The Dolomites have colored off. Herbert Krautgasser, Isolde Daldoss, Armin Holzer, family Piccolruaz and Egon Moroder Rusina radiate so much peace, satisfaction, the plump life. An Austria picture from Sudtirol designed by Sigrid Silgoner. / Funf Charakterkopfe haben eines gemeinsam: Sie finden sie leben in den schonsten Bergen der Welt. Sie fuhlen sich mit "ihren" Dolomiten verbunden, haben Demut vor den kantigen Zacken und den Launen der Natur."Hebs" betreut 150 Kuhe, 11 Pferde und 77 Schafe und spielt auf 2164 Meter rustikal Golf. "Isi" mag gar nicht mehr ins Tal hinunter, so fein hat sie es sich in ihrer Hutte auf Jochgrimm eingerichtet. Armin Holzer ist der blonde Jesus auf dem Gummiseil, der den Kick in der Hohe sucht. Und Familie Piccolruaz hutet zwei Schatze - die ladinische Sprache und ihren 800 Jahre Alfarèi-Hof. Dann bleibt noch Egon Moroder Rusina, der wie aus der Steinzeit entflohen scheint. Mit drei Ziegen und einer Henne haust der Maler im Sommer auf einer Alm im Zelt und ahmt den Atem im Nebel nach.Sie alle leben nicht im Gestern, im Gegenteil, sie haben den Stadtmenschen vieles voraus. Die Dolomiten haben abgefarbt. Herbert Krautgasser, Isolde Daldoss, Armin Holzer, Familie Piccolruaz und Egon Moroder Rusina strahlen so viel Ruhe, Zufriedenheit, das pralle Leben aus. Am Ende der Serie wird nur eine von ihnen als die stilvollste Frau des Landes gekront werden - und das groSSe Preisgeld von 20.000 Euro gewinnen!

programme.title: Container Wars / Container Wars
programme.desc: From now on, it is also made in the port: In the new series "Container Wars", the content of large ship containers from all over the world comes under the hammer. In this rapid business, however, not only a thick wallet is needed, but also a good eye and iron nerves to be successful. The auctioners only have a few minutes to get a first impression of the container. Therefore, you only know after the auction whether it was worth it or not. John Kunkle, who always has one or the other saying ready. The Israeli entrepreneur duo Shlomi and Uzi, the charming Sudlander Jason, the two Californians Ty and Mo, the experienced Matthew and the former Schonheitkonigin Deana, who wants to assert himself in the manner, are entitled to the bidders. / Ab sofort werden auch im Hafen Geschafte gemacht: In der neuen Serie "Container Wars" kommt der Inhalt von groSSen Schiffscontainern aus der ganzen Welt unter den Hammer. In diesem rasanten Business braucht es allerdings nicht nur einen dicken Geldbeutel, sondern auch ein gutes Auge und eiserne Nerven, um Erfolg zu haben. Den Auktionaren bleiben nur wenige Minuten, um sich einen ersten Eindruck vom Inhalt der Container zu verschaffen. Daher weiSS man auch erst nach der Versteigerung, ob sich das Geschaft gelohnt hat oder nicht. Die Auktionen ubernimmt die lokale Beruhmtheit John Kunkle, der immer den einen oder anderen Spruch parat hat. programme.title: Darts Party / Darts Party
programme.desc: "Darts Party" is anything but an ordinary tournament. 24 participants compete against each other in a competition lasting several weeks. Every week, six groups around the finals - among other things on rotating platforms, slippery soil or in front of flying barriers, can get on the board. Prazision, concentration and athletics are in demand - and deliver the best entertainment. At the end of the week, the four day winners meet in a tense weekly finals - only one makes the leap into the big series finale. / "Darts Party" ist alles andere als ein gewohnliches Turnier. 24 Teilnehmende treten in einem mehrwochigen Wettbewerb gegeneinander an. Jede Woche kampfen Sechsergruppen um den Einzug ins Finale - unter anderem auf drehenden Plattformen, rutschigen Boden oder vor fliegenden Barrieren.Erst wenn diese Hindernisse uberwunden sind, darf aufs Board gezielt werden. Prazision, Konzentration und Athletik sind gefragt - und liefern beste Unterhaltung. Am Ende der Woche treffen die vier Tagessieger in einem spannungsgeladenen Wochenfinale aufeinander - nur einer schafft den Sprung ins groSSe Serienfinale.

programme.title: Caretaker Krause - order must be / Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein
programme.desc: In the comedy series "Caretaker Krause", everything revolves around Dieter Krause (played by Tom Gerhardt), who would like to turn things to his advantage, but steps in all kinds of fat and in the "Kalker Weg 5" residential complex in Koln-Kalk has to take care of order. Unfortunately, he and some tenants have a completely different idea of ​​what that should mean. There is also some turbulence for the family man. Carmen did not expect that: her pregnancy test is positive. But who could be the father from the host of their admirers? In view of the illegitimate offspring, Dieter panic in this episode. If the physical is not to be found, replacement must be found. And who would be more suitable than Dieter's idiotic friend Herbert? But just when he could be convinced by his paternity, the biological father appears: a dream of a man ... / In der Comedy-Serie "Hausmeister Krause" dreht sich alles um Dieter Krause (gespielt von Tom Gerhardt), der die Dinge am liebsten zu seinem Vorteil drehen mochte, dabei aber in allerlei Fettnapfchen tritt und in der Wohnanlage "Kalker Weg 5" in Koln-Kalk alle Hande voll zu tun hat fur Ordnung zu sorgen. Leider haben er und einige Mieter eine ganz andere Vorstellung davon, was das bedeuten soll. Auch familiar gibt es einige Turbulenzen fur den Familienvater. Damit hat Carmen nicht gerechnet: Ihr Schwangerschaftstest ist positiv. Doch wer aus der Heerschar ihrer Verehrer konnte der Vater sein? Angesichts des unehelichen Nachwuchses gerat Dieter in dieser Episode in Panik. Wenn der Leibliche nicht aufzutreiben ist, muss eben Ersatz gefunden werden. programme.title: The crazed search for the Nazi shot / Die verruckte Suche nach dem Nazischatz

programme.title: Under Dinos - Secrets of prehistoric times / Unter Dinos - Geheimnisse der Urzeit
programme.desc: The film has the story of Albie, a young Pachyrhinosaur, who started the big journey to north with a super -herd 72 million years ago. The discovery of the research team around Emily Bamforth in northern Canada is spectacular: the remnants of a tremendous herd of Pachyrhinosaurs can be found at the excavation site. The massive vegetarians are particularly well known for their neck shield. Albie is part of a huge hike over more than 600 kilometers to new grazes - through river, swamps, forest and tuckical landing. In the middle of pounding footsters, whirled dust and rival bulls, Albie loses the connection - and his mother. But Pachyrhinosaurs have a special property that helps the little one in the search. The team around Emily Bamforth has found that the neck shields of the pachyrhinosaurs were unique and individually shaped - similar as a fingerprint. The researchers believe that these structures helped them to recognize each other themselves in the greatest herd. And actually Albie finds his mother. But not all of the dangers have been left for a long time: Gorgosaur, relatives of the Tyrannosaurus Rex lurk in the shade. And while the herd moves further north, an even biger threat is raised on the horizon: a huge storm that transforms the open landscape into an death of water, wind and mud. / Der Film erzahlt die Geschichte von Albie, einem jungen Pachyrhinosaurier, der vor 72 Millionen Jahren mit einer Superherde von Artgenossen die groSSe Reise nach Norden antrat.Die Entdeckung des Forschungsteams um Emily Bamforth im Norden Kanadas ist spektakular: Am Grabungsort finden sich die Überreste einer gewaltigen Herde von Pachyrhinosauriern. Die massigen Vegetarier sind besonders bekannt fur ihren Nackenschild.Albie ist Teil einer jahrlichen gewaltigen Wanderung uber mehr als 600 Kilometer zu neuen Weidegrunden - durch Flusse, Sumpfe, Walder und tuckisches Gelande. Inmitten von stampfenden FuSSen, aufgewirbeltem Staub und rivalisierenden Bullen verliert Albie den Anschluss - und seine Mutter. Aber Pachyrhinosaurier haben eine besondere Eigenschaft, die dem Kleinen bei der Suche hilft.Das Team um Emily Bamforth hat herausgefunden, dass die Nackenschilde der Pachyrhinosaurier einzigartig und individuell geformt waren - ahnlich wie ein Fingerabdruck. Die Forschenden glauben, dass diese Strukturen ihnen halfen, einander selbst in der groSSten Herde wiederzuerkennen.Und tatsachlich - Albie findet seine Mutter. programme.title: 37 ° life / 37°Leben
programme.desc: For the first time, a woman becomes a protective control in Lower Saxony Hankensbuttel. In the Rhineland-Palatinate Trier becomes a gulp wine. Not everyone is enthusiastic. It is something like that in 2024, after 365 years of club history a woman. Or Melika in Trier: Six years ago, she escaped from Iran. Now she has a high school diploma and a license, studies medicine. And advertises for wine. The film shows that not all local people were enthusiastic about this innovation. At the end of their reign, Anneke and Melika Resumee move, but they are also assessed. Both "koniginnen" identified strongly with their role. Both were elected for a year, sacrificed a lot of free time and money for their office. Both struck rejection and skepticism. With patience, will and with help, they have in office and were mastered, received the tradition and also broke a bit. What will remain of her reign and how did Annekes and Melika's view of home have changed? Anneke lives her connection to her home not only in her Lower Saxony home Hankensbuttel. As a Federal Border Guard Officer, she does her service at the German-Niederland border, the place where abroad becomes home, but where people also arrive who are looking for a new home. The former fleeing Melika has put a picture book integration and turned Trier into her homeland-without ifs and but. After learning the German language and the Abitur, their next challenges are the global license and a place of study in the subject of medicine. In film, Anneke and Melika live through the last weeks of their reign and at the same time the most important events: the Hankensbuttler Guardie Festival and the Olewig wine festival. A year of Konigin ends with farewells and many thoughts about the past few months. / Im niedersachsischen Hankensbuttel wird zum ersten Mal eine Frau Schutzenkonigin. Im rheinland-pfalzischen Trier wird eine Gefluchtete Weinkonigin. Nicht alle sind begeistert.Heimat verandert sich. Dass 2024, nach 365-jahriger Vereinsgeschichte erstmals eine Frau Schutzenkonigin wurde, ist sowas. Oder Melika in Trier: Vor sechs Jahren fluchtete sie aus dem Iran. Jetzt hat sie Abitur und Fuhrerschein, studiert Medizin. Und wirbt fur Wein.Der Film zeigt, dass langst nicht alle Ortsansassigen von dieser Neuerung begeistert waren. Am Ende ihrer Regentschaft ziehen Anneke und Melika Resumee, aber auch sie werden beurteilt. Beide "Koniginnen" identifizierten sich stark mit ihrer Rolle. Beide waren fur ein Jahr gewahlt, opferten viel Freizeit und Geld fur ihr Amt. Beiden schlug Ablehnung und Skepsis entgegen. Mit Geduld, Wille und mit Hilfe haben sie ihr Jahr in Amt und Wurden gemeistert, haben die Tradition erhalten und auch ein bisschen damit gebrochen. Was wird von ihrer Regentschaft bleiben und wie hat sich Annekes und Melikas Blick auf die Heimat verandert?Anneke lebt ihre Heimatverbundenheit nicht nur in ihrem niedersachsischen Zuhause Hankensbuttel. Als Bundesgrenzschutzbeamtin leistet sie ihren Dienst an der deutsch-niederlandischen Grenze, dem Ort, wo Ausland zu Heimat wird, wo aber auch Menschen ankommen, die eine neue Heimat suchen.Die ehemalige Gefluchtete Melika hat eine Bilderbuch-Integration hingelegt und Trier zu ihrer Heimat gemacht - ohne Wenn und Aber. Nach dem Erlernen der deutschen Sprache und dem Abitur sind ihre nachsten Herausforderungen der Fuhrerschein und ein Studienplatz im Fach Medizin.Im Film durchleben Anneke und Melika die letzten Wochen ihrer Regentschaft und gleichzeitig die wichtigsten Ereignisse: Das Hankensbuttler Schutzenfest und das Olewiger Weinfest. Ein Jahr Konigin endet mit Abschieden und vielen Gedanken zu den vergangenen Monaten.

programme.title: I play my game / Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes intended for children engaged in sports, irrelevant at which success level, will show the essential advantages that provide sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that in Montenegro has many talented children who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation on a bar for one step higher level. We want to draw attention to the potential belonging to us, which is indisputable, the potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. programme.title: Handball (F) - Champions League: Metz_Bondition / Rukomet (ž) - Liga šampiona: Metz_Budućnost
programme.desc: Under the interference of the European Handball Organization since 1961. The Champions League is held for the best female teams of the Old Continent. The first historical champion of Europe is a Bucharest Stint while the highest title of the winner of the competition has Spartak from Kiev, who won as many as 13 titles in the 1970s and in the 1980s. The format of the competition is such that the 16 best teams through a group phase and the quarterfinals hunt one of the four positions for the Final League League and the new European Champion is received through the semifinals and the finals. / Pod ingerencijom Evropske rukometne organizacije od 1961. godine održava se Liga šampiona za najbolje ženske ekipe Starog kontinenta. Prvi istorijski prvak Evrope je bukureštanska Stinta dok ukupno najviše titula pobjednika takmičenja ima Spartak iz Kijeva koji je sedamdesetih i osamdesetih godina prošlog vijeka osvojio čak 13 titula. Format takmičenja je takav da 16 najboljih ekipa kroz grupnu fazu i četvrtfinala lovi jednu od četiri pozicije za završni turnir Lige šampiona na kojem se preko polufinala i finala dobija novi prvak Evrope.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 316 / MMA UFC 316
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. programme.title: Football - Italian League: Verona - Sassuolo / Fudbal - Italijanska liga: Verona - Sassuolo
programme.desc: Seria A is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, Seria and she became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and coaches. / Seria A je profesionalno fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 ekipa u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Seria A postala je sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski fudbal se svojim kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi.

programme.title: Future Stars of the Arena / Buduće zvezde Arene
programme.desc: We present you successful young people who represent the future of sports in Serbia. Upoznajte sportistkinje i sportiste koji već u juniorskim takmičenjima ostvaruju izuzetne rezultate.

programme.title: They live for football / Oni žive za fudbal
programme.desc: The show for all lovers of this sport, which are fed up with industrial, high-cost football, for those who are a lot of tacticals and games without goals. The show will follow the matches played in the third rank of the football competition in Serbia. Every week we will present one match from all four groups of Serbian leagues, we will hear interesting interviews and see interesting attachments. / Emisija za sve ljubitelje ovog sporta, koji su se zasitili industrijskog, visokobudžetnog fudbala, za one kojima je dosta taktiziranja i utakmica bez golova. Emisija će pratiti utakmice koje se igraju u trećem rangu fudbalskog takmičenja u Srbiji. Svake nedelje predstavićemo po jednu utakmicu iz sve četiri grupe srpske lige, čućemo zanimljive intervjue i videti interesantne priloge.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Osasuna - Getafe / Fudbal - Španska liga: Osasuna - Getafe
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path set after the hand of Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team of Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspešnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Basketball - Spanish superb: Valencia - Real Madrid, Finals / Košarka - Španski Superkup: Valencia - Real Madrid, finale
programme.desc: The Super Cup Spain in the basketball is a yearly basketball competition in Spain. It is held before the start of the season of the Endes League. It was founded in 1984. and in the original version was held until 1988, in 2004. was restored with a slightly altered competition system. / Superkup Španije u košarci je godišnje košarkaško takmičenje u Španiji. programme.title: Football - French League: Paris - Lorient / Fudbal - Francuska liga: Paris - Lorient
programme.desc: Ligue 1 The first is the French professional football league that has 20 teams in the fight for the title of France champions. It was founded in 1932. years and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The most trophy club with ten won titles is AS Saint Etienne but the green on the new title is waiting since 1981. years and the times of the Great Michel Platini. The encounters of the French league are an unavoidable event for every lover of this magnificent game. / Ligue 1 prva je francuska profesionalna fudbalska liga koja broji 20 ekipa u borbi za titulom prvaka Francuske. Osnovana je 1932. godine i smatra se jednom od najcenjenijih evropskih liga. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali Zeleni na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

programme.title: Handball - Ehf League Champion: Pelister - Gog / Rukomet - EHF Liga šampiona: Pelister - GOG
programme.desc: The champions handball league has since 1955. year when the competition was founded under the name Cup Champions. We received the first winner in the 1956-1957 season. years, and that was the threshold team because only city selections were performed at that season. Today, that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993. The competition was held under that name and played according to the Cup system on the relegation. Since 1993. In addition to changing the name in the Champion League, the group phase of the competition was introduced after which the following are elimination. The group stage changed with years and was introduced and FAINAL FOR FOR FOUR FOUR FOUR CROATIES OF EUROPE AFTER that the champion was obtained. / Rukometna Liga šampiona svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu šampiiona uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama menjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Football - Polish League: Drive - Piast / Fudbal - Poljska liga: Pogon - Piast
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league of Poland. The first league of Poland in football was founded in 1927. years. This league is organized by the Football Association of Poland (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league. The champion directly wins the title of the Polish champion. The number of teams changed with years, the 90s participated in 18 and in the 30s only 10. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu, osnovana je 1927. godine. Ovu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno, u ligi učestvuje 16 ekipa. Prvak direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona. Broj ekipa se sa godinama menjao, 90-ih učestvovalo ih je 18, a 30-ih samo 10.

programme.title: Fudbal - Ruska Liga: Dynamo Makhachkala - Sochi / Fudbal - Ruska liga: Dynamo Makhachkala - Sochi
programme.desc: The Russian Football League recorded his competition beginnings since 1936. Even though soccer in the federal area played since 1900. The most successful team during that time is Moscow Spartak Although the beginning of the second part of the century is more successful clubs like CSKA Moscow and Zenith from St. Petersburg. League until the season 2012/2013. She played in the period spring - autumn for a long winter and has been played classically European autumn since then. Great financial investments in Russian football clubs have much closer to the league at the UEFINE LEASTICS of the first league coefficients in force in Europe. / Ruska fudbalska liga kao naslednik Sovjetskog saveza beleži svoje takmičarske početke od 1936. godine iako se fudbal na području saveza igrao još od 1900ih. Najuspješnija ekipa za to vreme je Moskovski Spartak iako od početka drugog dela veka uspješniji su klubovi poput CSKA Moskve i Zenita iz St. Petersburga. Liga se sve do sezone 2012./2013. igrala u terminu proleće - jesen zbog dugačke zime te se od tada igra klasično evropski jesen - proleće. programme.title: Football - Spanish 2. League: Ceuta - Eibar / Fudbal - Španska 2. liga: Ceuta - Eibar

Uncertain matches and high levels of football quality and the technical aspect of the game consists of Segunda extremely media-accompanied competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. programme.title: Basketball - NBA League: Denver - La Clippers, G7 / Košarka - NBA liga: Denver - LA Clippers, G7
programme.desc: The sixth day of June of June 1946. years will change the basketball game forever. On that day in New York, the most elite world basketball competition, the NBA league was founded. 29 Teams from the US and one from Canada Each autumn begins the hunt for the legendary ring intended for the Champions of the NBA league. The teams are divided into an east and western conference and through 82 regular season, the regular season hunting one of the eight playoff positions. Conference champions are entering the large NBA final where in a series of a maximum of seven games decide on the new champion. The NBA final is one of the most accurate sports events of the year that delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna meseca davne 1946. godine zauvek će promeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gde u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.

programme.title: Endurance Auto Race: 6 Hours Funzhia: 7. Race: 6 Hours Funzhia (J) / Endurance avtomobilska dirka: 6 ur Fudžija: 7. Dirka: 6 ur Fudžija (J)
programme.desc: The FIA ​​World Race World Championships stopped on the legendary Fuji Speedway track in Japan for its seventh race of the season. At the tense six -hour race, the factory teams in the Hypercar class and strong participants in the LMP2 and GT classes offered the highest level. In front of enthusiastic fans, an exciting duel in strategy, speed and steel nerves developed. The highlights are marked by spectacular overtaking maneuvers, dramatic scenes in the race and the fight for decisive points of the World Cup in the penultimate race of the season. / FIA Svetovno prvenstvo v vzdržljivostnih dirkah se je za svojo sedmo dirko sezone ustavilo na legendarni stezi Fuji Speedway na Japonskem. Na napeti šesturni dirki so tovarniške ekipe v razredu Hypercar ter močni udeleženci v razredih LMP2 in GT ponudili motošport na najvišji ravni. Pred navdušenimi navijači se je razvil razburljiv dvoboj v strategiji, hitrosti in jeklenih živcih. Vrhunce zaznamujejo spektakularni prehitevalni manevri, dramatični prizori na dirki in boj za odločilne točke svetovnega prvenstva v predzadnji dirki sezone.

programme.desc: A brand new series of "container war" proves that a good balance in the bank account does not yet guarantee success in the world of port auctions, in which everything is happening at a flash pace. Volleyball: Men's Super Cup: Dresden SC - SSC Palmberg Schwerin / Odbojka: moški superpokal: Dresdner SC - SSC Palmberg Schwerin
programme.desc: Schwerin masters will compete with the winners of the DVV Pokala in Super Cup. In April, the volleyball players from the Mecklenburg-Predpomorian beat Sashinja 3: 2 and won the thirteenth title of national champions. After several actresses left the club - including the League star Elles Dambrink - the Annegret Holzig team captain is more important than ever. After the early break of the volleyball Bundesliga due to the coronavirus, Comdirect SuperCup again brought top -notch volleyball to Sport1 as the first highlight of the new season. United Volleys Frankfurt and Berlin Recycling Volleys compete today at a male superb in Frankfurt. The Berliners won the trophy for the first time last year with a reliable 3-0 victory against VFB Friedrichshafen. Unlike the previous years, the Super Cup for women and men is not going together this year. SSC Palmberg Schwerin and Dresdner SC played their match at the end of September. / Mojstrice iz Schwerina se bodo v Superpokalu pomerile z zmagovalkami DVV-pokala. Aprila so odbojkarice iz Mecklenburg-Predpomorjanske premagale Sašinje s 3:2 in osvojile trinajsti naslov državnih prvakinj. Potem ko je več igralk zapustilo klub – med njimi zvezdnica lige Elles Dambrink – je kapetanka ekipe Annegret Holzig pomembnejša kot kdajkoli prej.Po predčasni prekinitvi odbojkarske Bundeslige zaradi koronavirusa je comdirect Supercup kot prvi vrhunec nove sezone znova prinesel vrhunsko odbojko v živo na SPORT1. Na moškem Superpokalu v Frankfurtu se danes pomerita United Volleys Frankfurt in BERLIN RECYCLING Volleys. Berlinčani so si lani prvič priborili pokal z zanesljivo zmago 3:0 proti VfB Friedrichshafen. Za razliko od prejšnjih let Superpokal za ženske in moške letos ne poteka skupaj. SSC Palmberg Schwerin in Dresdner SC sta svojo tekmo odigrala že konec septembra.

programme.title: Football (M): Hoffenheim - Koln, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Hoffenheim - Koln, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, starting matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Maribor, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Illyricvm, co -producing film / Illyricvm, koprodukcijski film
programme.sub-title: Illyricvm; Leto 37 pr. n. št. Mlademu pastirju Liburnu Volsusu poglavar nekega rivalskega barbarskega plemena posili in umori ženo in tako se ta odpravi na pot maščevanja. Na poti naleti na rimsko legijo in se ji pridruži kot nosač. Dobro spozna vsakdan
programme.desc: Volsus joins the soldiers of the legion in a seemingly simple task of collecting taxes, which turns into a tense and unexpected encounter with a combined meeting with the seemingly subdued Illyrian nobles there. Through the eyes of this primitive primitive Barbara, we follow the archaic world of strange, brutal laws and customs that are similar to our modern world than we would initially expect. For our spaces, stunning historical film focuses on the reconstruction of the life and customs of Illyrian tribes and Roman soldiers in the Roman Empire. Particular attention was paid to the credible depiction of language, costumes and props, with experts from various fields participating. Reading: Illyricvmlet Production: 20222 St. Bardhi, Robert Prebil, Adrian Pezdirc. / Volsus se pridruži vojakom legije pri na videz preprosti nalogi pobiranja davkov, ki se sprevrže v napeto in z nepričakovanimi obrati prepleteno srečanje s tamkajšnjimi dozdevno pokorjenimi ilirskimi plemeni. Skozi oči tega za Rimljane primitivnega barbara spremljamo arhaičen svet čudnih, brutalnih zakonov in običajev, ki so našemu sodobnemu svetu podobni bolj, kot bi sprva pričakovali.Za naše prostore osupljiv zgodovinski film se osredotoča na čim natančnejšo rekonstrukcijo življenja in običajev ilirskih plemen in rimskih vojakov v času rimskega imperija. Posebna pozornost je bila namenjena verodostojni upodobitvi jezika, kostumov in rekvizitov, pri čemer so sodelovali strokovnjaki z različnih področij.Originalni naslov: ILLYRICVMLeto produkcije: 2022Država: koprodukcijaŽanr: zgodovinska dramaRežija: Simon Bogojević NarathScenarij: Simon Bogojević NarathIgrajo: Filip Križan, Ylber Bardhi, Robert Prebil, Adrian Pezdirc.

programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.
